candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool.size=5 with idle=0 and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST 503 and gateway checkout 502s after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or saturation time series; pool size/idle values come only from span attributes.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with DependencyUnavailable while pool idle=0, propagating 503 from order and 502 at gateway; logs confirm transport errors to order. Redis and payment calls succeed, so pool exhaustion at postgres is the bounded leading cause.
